text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Heading into the cafe, Fuji Kiseki had 
just finished lunch with her juniors."

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-senpai, that limited-edition caramel 
banana cake everyone was talking about was 
so delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's true. It was very delicious. 
But more than anything—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just being able to see you enjoy eating 
your cake makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, I have somewhere to be, so I'll be 
going now. Invite me again sometime.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah... Just a bit of heartburn.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I eat sweets, sometimes I end up 
like this... haha.
